## Summary

Describe the user or operator outcome and why the change is needed.

## Data and publication safety

- [ ] No new establishment can be published implicitly.
- [ ] Source rights, retention, provenance, and TTL boundaries remain enforced.
- [ ] Database changes are additive, least-privilege, and represented by a migration.
- [ ] Scheduled work is bounded, retryable, and observable.

## Validation

List the local checks, production-safe queries, and rollout or rollback checks performed.
